samples.summary: Citizens Bank phishing: detect IP-hosted account-confirmation lure
samples.behavior: Static 2004 Citizens Bank impersonation with genuine bank imagery and a suspension threat directing account confirmation to http://219.144.194.158/CitizensBank/OnlineBanking/index.html.
samples.limits: No form, script, embedded payload or proven credential transmission in the supplied HTML.

samples.summary: All-Yours card lure: detect executable pickup and image disguise
samples.behavior: Word 9 exported HTML dated December 2005, impersonating All-Yours Greeting Cards and asking the recipient to open http://www.freeforall.home.ro/postcard.gif.exe.
samples.limits: Disguised executable delivery link; no local executable bytes or demonstrated execution. Corrected image-URL false positive on the .gif.exe suffix.

samples.summary: Apple support scam: detect phone coercion and iTunes click flood
samples.behavior: Apple phone-support scareware with fabricated breach and personal-data-transfer warnings. Decodes the phone query parameter and writes it into font.phoneNumber.innerHTML. Appends itunes:hello%00 ahead of other anchors and attempts 30 first-anchor clicks.
samples.limits: Local jquery/bootstrap dependencies absent. A ready callback references undefined winH/winW; a final click loop references undefined elems. No proven browser crash, information transfer or successful protocol-handler launch.

analysis: Verified SHA-256 and HTML syntax/links with HTMLParser.
Ran initial and final atomscan and cleave facts for every sample; facts contain ASCII text with no decoded payloads, symbols, executable structure or extracted archive members.
Reviewed every inline script and traced DOM order, parameter handling and protocol-link clicks; Rizin reports no native code.
No remote retrieval needed to establish malicious behavior; no dependencies are present alongside 11.html.

checks: JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP accepted, including query and fragment suffixes.
Image-looking executable suffixes, further path segments and query-only image names rejected.
